items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, [bloomy?], we were together. And Elvin… It was a date for J. J. Johnson, I think.

ctx.x: And Elvin Jones. Ed Thigpen. Oh… you want to talk about Elvin. [laughs]
Oh, Elvin. Yeah. That was a [inaudible] [Gelder?], at the studio in Jersey. Oh, [bloomy?], we were together. And Elvin… It was a date for J. J. Johnson, I think.
